text:
Evan: Hey folks, scheduled my spouse for a minor outpatient procedure and the hospital is saying the insurer rejected preauth because the member ID didn’t match the subscriber. The ID on the digital card shows my maiden name (old HR record) but our benefits file has my updated name. How do we fix so claim/preauth goes through?
Priya (People Ops): Sorry! That sounds like a dependent + subscriber name mismatch in the carrier feed. Two quick paths: 1) update the carrier with the corrected dependent name/relationship (we can submit a roster update), or 2) get a corrected ID card (digital or physical) to present to the facility. DM me the patient DOB and provider contact and I’ll start the update.
Evan: Patient DOB is 2015-06-08 (our dependent). Hospital wants a corrected ID now or they might deny and bill me. Surgery is booked for 2026-04-02.
Tara (Benefits): If there’s a preauth in progress, we can also submit a manual coverage confirmation letter to the facility while the carrier updates membership. Please send the facility name, MRN if you have it, and the preauth/case number. I can draft the letter with our plan contact details.
Scheduler (Health Advocate): Hospitals accept an eligibility letter + member proof in many cases. We can provide a one-page eligibility verification PDF: member name (Evan), dependent (name), subscriber ID (ends with 4321), plan name, and coverage window. That usually holds them while the carrier fixes the card. Want me to generate it now?
Evan: Yes please, that would be great. Also curious: why did the digital card show my maiden name? I updated my name in Workday two months ago.
Priya (People Ops): Likely an integration lag: HR -> carrier Roster sync runs nightly but some carriers require a separate manual roster push for name changes or have a 7-14 day processing period. We can force a manual push to the carrier's enrollment team and request an expedited member update.
carrier-bot: Enrollment sync status: last successful sync 2026-03-12T03:14Z. Pending manual update option available. Link: https://benefits.redwood.com/enroll-sync.
Tara (Benefits): Evan — please DM me a screenshot of the digital card + the Workday name change confirmation (or a copy of your updated SS card if you uploaded one). I’ll attach those to the roster update request. I’ll also create the eligibility verification letter and upload it to the hospital portal.
Evan: DM’d everything. Thanks Tara. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Scheduler (Health Advocate): Generated eligibility PDF and uploaded to St. Mercy portal (confirmation #SM-8812). I also sent a message to the hospital billing coordinator to hold any final claims until coverage is confirmed.
Priya (People Ops): We requested an expedited roster update with the carrier and asked for an updated digital ID. Carrier turnaround for expedited name corrections is typically 48-72 business hours. If they won’t expedite, use the eligibility PDF at check-in and ask for claim hold.
Evan: Hospital accepted the eligibility letter at pre-op visit and said they’ll proceed. Preauth still pending but they removed the denial flag for now. Thanks everyone :relieved:
Tara (Benefits): Marking this thread for follow-up. If you receive any EOBs with a denial after the date of service, forward them to benefits@redwood.com with subject "Dependent ID mismatch appeal - Evan" and we’ll reopen with carrier.
Evan: Will do. Big help, really relieved.
